data.description:
Discovered while implementing AH-0MT7VE4SX0005A8V (Add Magnet power-up, a docs-only GDD change) in AI_Hell, a repository with no package.json and no build tooling.

Problem: the audit runner's Phase 1 merge gate (_integrate_into_dev in skills/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py) unconditionally runs 'npm run build' after merging the item's work into an integration worktree. For a repo without package.json this fails with ENOENT and the gate reports 'Merge gate blocked: integration failed: build failed' -> 'Ready to close: No', demoting the item to open/plan_complete. The git merge itself succeeded (rc=0), so the change is valid; only the hard-coded build fails.

Impact: any docs-only item in a repo without build tooling cannot pass the audit merge gate when its work is not yet in dev. Workaround (used for AH-0MT7VE4SX0005A8V): commit + push to dev FIRST, then audit — the gate's _verify_merged_in_dev detects the work already in origin/dev and proceeds fail-open without attempting the build.

Suggested fix (agent-infrastructure, outside this repo's boundaries): make the build step conditional on the integration worktree having package.json (or a configured build command, e.g. .pi/test-config.json buildCommand), or make it a recorded non-blocking note when no build tooling exists.
